sloka: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् ।कर्त्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम् ॥ २.११२.१०॥
transliteration: rājadharmamanuprekṣya kuladharmānusantatim ।karttumarhasi kākutstha mama mātuśca yācanām ॥ 2.112.10॥

translations.english: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.
